card.name: Small words before cancer-study terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces or hyphens just before a long-term animal study is described in carcinogenicity sections, where cancer or tumor words come next. Examples are 'with' before 'a carcinogenic agent' and the gap before '2-year'.

modes.label: Link word before carcinogen
modes.description: Words like with, a or to that come right before a cancer-causing agent or exposure.
modes.example: A tumor-promoting effect of both metabolites was observed when they were coadministered<< with>> a carcinogenic agent.

modes.label: Study duration lead-in
modes.description: The space, 'of' or '-year' just before a study length such as 2-year or 24-month in carcinogenicity studies.
modes.example: In a 2<<-year>> study in rats at three oral dosage levels

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict cancer words such as carcinogenic, carcinoma and cancer next.
card.plain: It fires on small words right before the text talks about cancer-causing effects in long animal studies.
